title: NGINX UI partner keyring
description: The partner keyring the Nginx UI project publishes as v1/partners.json next to the official catalog v1/index.json, schema_version 1 (spec/08-security.md SEC-25 through SEC-29, RFC 0013). A release key signs its exact bytes in v1/partners.json.minisig, and a host verifies that signature before it parses the document. Only the keyring of the official catalog counts. Unknown members are ignored by a host, so the schema allows them.

schema_version.description: The only keyring layout spec 1.x defines. A host does not use a document with another value and keeps its cached keyring (SEC-26).

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 time of this version. Every new version carries a later time, and a host refuses a document older than the keyring it cached (SEC-27).

partners.description: Partner keys. A listed key whose entry has not expired makes a package it signs verified without a certificate, unless its key id is revoked (SEC-18, SEC-28).

revoked.description: Revoked partner key ids. A revoked key never gives verified, whether a certificate or an entry of partners names it (SEC-28).

partnerName.description: PKG-26: the partner name, ASCII letters, digits, dots and hyphens, the same syntax as in a partner certificate.

date.description: SEC-29: a day of the UTC calendar as YYYY-MM-DD. The entry is valid through the whole of that day by the host's clock.

keyId.description: The 16 hexadecimal digits minisign prints for a key (SEC-24), compared without regard to case.

publicKey.description: PKG-25: a minisign public key in the text form of a .pub file, an untrusted comment line and the key line, or the key line alone.

expires.description: SEC-29: the last day the entry is valid. Absent means the entry does not expire.
